claims.source_quote_ar: الواو بمعنى «مع» يعنى: فأجمعوا أمركم مع شركاؤكم.
claims.claim_ar: ربط الفعلين بـ«واو» يحقق وصل المعنى واستمراريته بين صفتَي المؤمنين (آمَنُوا وَكَانُوا يَتَّقُونَ)، وهو نوع من فصل-وصل البلاغي الذي يجمع بين الرابط والمعنى.
claims.claim_en: The connective waw links the two verbs, producing continuity of meaning between the descriptions of the believers (they believed and were righteous). This is a rhetorical instance of 'fasl-wa-wasl' (separation-and-joining) where the conjunction both connects and sustains the flow.
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited commentary discusses the waw's rhetorical value generally; it is an inference to this specific verse rather than an explicit statement about these exact words.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Creates smooth continuity and cumulative characterization — the conjunction ties belief to God-fearing as a sustained, linked trait.

claims.claim_ar: العبارة الموجزة «ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَكَانُوا يَتَّقُونَ» تضغط معانٍ ثلاثية (الإيمان، الدوام على حال الإيمان، والورع) في صيغة مختصرة ومقتضبة، وهي حالة من إعجاز البيان والاقتصاد اللفظي.
claims.claim_en: The concise phrase 'those who believed and were pious' compresses several related meanings (belief, constancy of belief, God-fearing conduct) into a compact expression; this exemplifies i'jaz (conciseness/inimitability) in rhetorical organization.
claims.needs_review_reason: The quoted passage treats Quranic eloquence generally; attributing i'jaz to this specific clause is an informed inference rather than a directly stated analysis in the provided chunks.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Compression of meaning increases memorability and force — a short formula conveys multifold qualities efficiently and emphatically.
